appearance_facts.fact: The CA polygon is filled with the darkest maroon color on the map, visually matching the top of the color scale.
The TN polygon is filled with a very light cream color, visually matching the bottom of the color scale.
The DE polygon is filled with a light orange color, positioned in the lower-middle range of the color scale.
The vertical color bar on the right shows a gradient from light cream (labeled Low) to dark maroon (labeled High).

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
Legend labels include 'High' at the top, 'Low' at the bottom, and numerical ticks '100', '80', '60', '40', '20'.
Footnote reads: 'Clean choropleth: same US map base; darker color means higher true value.'.
State abbreviations are printed within their respective polygons, including CA, TN, and DE.
